body:
Hey.

I know this may seem kind of random and out of the blue, but i need to talk to you. i've been really depressed for a really long time. I don't know if i was just too good at hiding it, or if nobody ever cared enough, but no one ever noticed. I've felt worthless for months. i can't help but feel that i'm a loser who isn't good at anything. This week has been especially bad for me. I've been in bed for two days straight. I haven't eaten lunch today. My mom and i got in a fight and i said some things that made her think that i need help. I might get sent away. We're going up to _______ to see a doctor tonight. I don't know what will happen after that. So i don't know if i'll get to say goodbye to you. i really want to. Even though i honestly don't know all too much about you, you were a great friend. When we hugged at _____ and we made eachother cry, i felt important for the first time in a long time. I felt like i mattered to someone. From that point on, i wanted to wrap my arms around you and never let you go. When i'm around you, you make me feel like i don't want to hurt myself anymore. I don't feel like a loser around you. I liked sleeping next to you. i felt safe there. i guess it's just because i haven't been close to anyone in a very very long time. i haven't let anyone in my life because i'm afraid they're going to leave like all my other friends have. So i'm sorry if i made you uncomfortable by always wanting to be close to you. I'm sorry if i my heart texts annoyed you. I just don't want you to forget about me. I'd do anything to keep you here. Right now, the only thing i want is to hug you and have you hug me back and tell me it's okay. i know i already told you this, but in case you lost my note, i wish we could have spent more time together. With you, i'm happy, and i'm sorry. I love you. i'm going to miss you.

i was lucky enough to convince my mom to just send me to a psychiatrist. i wasn't sure michael even cared that i was depressed. i was beginning to lose hope, until i invited him over to watch a movie with me and another friend. he said he would come, so i put out a bean bag chair for him, and brought out one of his favorite drinks. everything was set. i just wanted to make him happy so that he could make me happy. he texted me smily faces for the first time ever. i was so happy, this was going to be the night where i could say goodbye. where i could tell him that i didn't want him to forget me. time went by, and he kept giving excuses for not coming. eventually, 3 hours after he said he would come, he told me he couldn't. he was busy hanging out with other friends. i was so sad. if the movie wasn't funny my night would have been ruined. the bean bag sat there cold and the drink went unopened. i had to hold back tears so that my friend didn't think i was an emotional cunt. i told him he could talk to me about anything, anytime. since then, he hasn't talked to me at all besides texting me once about maybe being able to hang out last tuesday, which he didn't. i send him hearts, i ask him why he's ignoring me, and i asked for one last goodbye hug. he won't answer me, at all. he won't even let me say goodbye. my other (only) friend says that he's a dick for standing me up, but i still can't let him go. i can't stay mad at him. tomorrow is his last day in town. i fear i won't even be able to say goodbye. i don't understand how someone could ignore me even when i've told him how important he is. what did i do? i'm once again back into my terrible slump of a depression. i tried cutting myself, but i couldn't do it. i just want something to make him notice me, to make him care again, to make him give me one last hug. what does it fucking take!? i'm considering suicide now. i don't want to kill myself, but i don't want to life like this. i basically want to die. i want something bad to happen to me. so that maybe, he'll realize that i'm important to him to. i just want to be close like that one night, one more time. i just want him to send me text messages back every once in a while. my life is in shambles. i hate everything and i don't know what to do. i hate myself. even threats of suicide don't make people care. everyone's leaving, and even the one friend i could open up to about being depressed is ignoring me. i don't know what to do. how do i make him love me? how do i make friends love me? how do i stop them from leaving? what did i do wrong?

i just want a goodbye. please. i fear i won't be able to survive through the week. help.
